examples.answer:

examples.question: Match seasons with typical weather characteristics in Viet Nam: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter vs hot/sunny, cold/dry, warm/humid, cool/windy.
examples.answer:
• Spring - warm/humid (Mùa xuân - ấm áp, ẩm ướt)
• Summer - hot/sunny (Mùa hè - nóng, nắng nhiều)
• Autumn - cool/windy (Mùa thu - mát mẻ, có gió)
• Winter - cold/dry (Mùa đông - lạnh, khô)

examples.question: Complete the sentence with the correct place noun and preposition: 'The post office (bưu điện) is ______ (đối diện) the bakery (tiệm bánh), and it is ______ (ở giữa) the bookshop (hiệu sách) and the pharmacy (hiệu thuốc).'
examples.answer:
• opposite (đối diện), between (ở giữa).
• Full sentence: 'The post office is opposite the bakery, and it is between the bookshop and the pharmacy.'

name: Food & Drink: Would like to eat/drink

examples.question: Fill in the blanks with food/drink vocabulary and 'would like': 'What ______ you like to eat? - I'd like some ______ (nem) and ______ (phở).' 'What would you like to drink? - I'd like some ______ (nước cam).'
examples.answer:
• would; spring rolls (nem); noodles (phở); orange juice (nước cam).
• Structure: What would you like to eat/drink? -> I'd like some + [danh từ chỉ đồ ăn/thức uống].

examples.question: Put the verb in brackets into the correct form and position of adverb: 'She (always / water) ______ the flowers in the morning.'
examples.answer:
• Correct form: 'She always waters the flowers in the morning.'
• Rule: S + Adverb of Frequency (always/usually/often/sometimes) + V(s/es) for He/She/It.

name: Past Simple Tense (Thì Quá khứ đơn)

examples.question: Supply the past forms of irregular verbs: Yesterday, my family (go) ______ to Ha Long Bay, (see) ______ beautiful caves, and (take) ______ many photos.
examples.answer:
• go -> went
• see -> saw
• take -> took
• Full sentence: 'Yesterday, my family went to Ha Long Bay, saw beautiful caves, and took many photos.'

name: Future Plans: Will vs Be going to

examples.question: Choose 'will' or 'be going to' for the plans: (1) Where ______ (you / visit) this summer? - I ______ visit Hue Imperial City. (2) ______ you decorate your home for Tet? - Yes, I ______.
examples.answer:
• (1) 'are you going to visit' / 'am going to' (kế hoạch nghỉ hè đã được sắp xếp/quyết định từ trước)
• (2) 'Will' / 'will' (quyết định/lời hứa được đưa ra ngay tại thời điểm nói)
• Rule: 'Be going to' + V dùng cho kế hoạch, dự định đã được sắp xếp hoặc quyết định từ trước khi nói; 'Will' dùng cho quyết định tức thời, lời hứa, hoặc dự đoán không dựa trên kế hoạch có sẵn. Việc chọn 'will' hay 'be going to' phụ thuộc vào thời điểm ra quyết định, không phụ thuộc vào việc đó là kỳ nghỉ hay lễ Tết.

examples.question: Complete the weather forecast using 'will': 'Tomorrow, it ______ (be) sunny in the morning, but it ______ (be) rainy in the afternoon.'
examples.answer:
• will be; will be.
• Structure: S + will + be + adjective (sunny/rainy/cloudy/windy) để nói về dự báo thời tiết trong tương lai.
• Ví dụ: 'Tomorrow, it will be sunny in the morning, but it will be rainy in the afternoon.'

examples.question: Write questions for the underlined frequency answer: '______? - He plays basketball twice a week.'
examples.answer:
• Question: 'How often does he play basketball?'
• Structure: How often + do/does + S + V(bare)? -> S + V(s/es) + once/twice/three times a week.

examples.question: Complete the distance question and answer: '______ is it from your home to your school? - It's ______ two kilometres.'
examples.answer:
• Question: 'How far is it from your home to your school?'
• Answer: 'It's about two kilometres.'
• Structure: How far is it from [A] to [B]? -> It's about + [distance] kilometres.

examples.question: Fill in 'should' or 'shouldn't': Nam has a high fever. He ______ stay in bed and he ______ drink cold water.
examples.answer:
• Answer: should / shouldn't
• Rule: S + should / shouldn't + V(bare) (Nên / Không nên làm gì).

name: Future Career Desires: Would like to be...

examples.question: Complete the career aspiration question and reason: 'What would you like to ______ in the future? - I'd like to be a teacher because I'd like to ______ children.'
examples.answer:
• Answer: be / teach
• Structure: What would you like to be in the future? -> I'd like to be a/an [job]. Why? -> Because I'd like to [action].

name: Would like to + Verb: Visit / Eat / Drink

examples.question: Complete with 'would like to' + verb: 'Which place ______ you ______ visit? - I'd like to visit Sa Pa because the weather is cool.'
examples.answer:
• would; like to.
• Structure: Which place would you like to visit? -> I'd like to visit + [địa danh] + because + [lý do].
• Lưu ý: 'would like to' + động từ nguyên mẫu, dùng để diễn tả mong muốn một cách lịch sự (không chỉ dùng cho nghề nghiệp mà còn dùng cho nơi muốn đến, món muốn ăn/uống,...).

name: Prepositions of Place (Giới từ chỉ vị trí)

examples.question: Choose the correct preposition: 'The bookshop is ______ (bên cạnh) the bakery. The park is ______ (đối diện) the school.'
examples.answer:
• next to (bên cạnh); opposite (đối diện).
• Rule: next to = ngay bên cạnh; between A and B = ở giữa A và B; opposite = đối diện, phía bên kia.

examples.question: Mark the rising (↗) or falling (↘) intonation for: (a) Did you go to the party? (b) Where did you go last weekend? (c) I went to the countryside.
examples.answer:
• (a) Did you go to the party? ↗ (Rising intonation for Yes/No questions)
• (b) Where did you go last weekend? ↘ (Falling intonation for Wh- questions)
• (c) I went to the countryside. ↘ (Falling intonation for statements)

examples.question: Identify the primary stress position in these 2-syllable and 3-syllable words: 'dolphin, 'friendly, a'bove, 'bakery, No'vember.
examples.answer:
• 'dolphin (1st syllable - noun)
• 'friendly (1st syllable - adjective)
• a'bove (2nd syllable - preposition)
• 'bakery (1st syllable)
• No'vember (2nd syllable)

examples.question: Complete the direction conversation: 'A: Excuse me, how can I get to the art room? - B: ______ upstairs and turn ______. It's on your right.'
examples.answer:
• Answer: Go / left
• Dialogue: 'A: Excuse me, how can I get to the art room? - B: Go upstairs and turn left. It's on your right.'

name: Sharing a Trip (Kể về chuyến đi)

examples.question: Fill in the past trip dialogue: 'A: Where did you go last weekend? - B: We ______ to Phu Quoc Island. - A: What did you do there? - B: We ______ in the sea and ate seafood.'
examples.answer:
• Answer: went / swam
• Polite opening: 'How was your trip? - It was fantastic!'

examples.question: Complete the doctor-patient dialogue: 'A: What's the matter with you, Quan? - B: I have a severe ______. - A: You should go to the dentist. - B: OK, I will. Thanks!'
examples.answer:
• Answer: toothache
• Polite response to advice: 'OK, I will. Thanks for your advice!'

examples.question: Match Questions with Answers: (1) What would you like to be in the future? (2) Why would you like to be a doctor? -> (A) Because I'd like to look after sick people. (B) I'd like to be a doctor.
examples.answer:
• 1 - B: What would you like to be in the future? - I'd like to be a doctor.
• 2 - A: Why would you like to be a doctor? - Because I'd like to look after sick people.
• Encourage response: 'Cool! That sounds great!'

examples.question: Complete the dialogue: 'A: What would you like to eat? - B: I'd like some ______. - A: And what would you like to drink? - B: I'd like some ______, please.'
examples.answer:
• Suggested answer: spring rolls / lemonade.
• Full dialogue: 'A: What would you like to eat? - B: I'd like some spring rolls. - A: And what would you like to drink? - B: I'd like some lemonade, please.'

name: Weather Forecast Q&A (Dự báo thời tiết)

examples.question: Complete the weather dialogue: 'A: What will the weather be like tomorrow? - B: It ______ be ______ and ______.'
examples.answer:
• Suggested answer: will / sunny / hot.
• Full dialogue: 'A: What will the weather be like tomorrow? - B: It will be sunny and hot.'
